frames.data:
gt sync

Sync all branches with remote, prompting to delete any branches for PRs that have been merged or closed. Resta
cks all branches in your repository that can be restacked without conflicts. If trunk cannot be fast-forwarded
 to match remote, overwrites trunk with the remote version.

Global options:
      --cwd          Working directory in which to perform operations.                                [string]
      --debug        Write debug output to the terminal.                            [boolean] [default: false]
      --interactive  Enable interactive features like prompts, pagers, and editors. Enabled by default. Disabl
                     e with `--no-interactive`.                                      [boolean] [default: true]
      --verify       Enable git hooks. Enabled by default. Disable with `--no-verify`.
                                                                                     [boolean] [default: true]
  -q, --quiet        Minimize output to the terminal. Implies

`--no-interactive`.   [boolean] [default: false]

Options:
      --help        Show help for a command.                                        [boolean] [default: false]
      --restack     Restack any branches that can be restacked without conflicts (true by default; skip with -
                    -no-restack).                                                    [boolean] [default: true]
  -f, --force       Don't prompt for confirmation before overwriting or deleting a branch in any place where c
                    onfirmation is requested.                                       [boolean] [default: false]
  -d, --delete-all  Delete all merged or closed branches during sync without prompting. This only affects bran
                    ch cleanup; to persist it, enable the sync cleanup setting in `gt config`.
                                                                                    [boolean] [default: false]
  -a, --all         Sync branches across all configured trunks.
